results.title: Membership FAQs - AVP Beach Volleyball
results.content:
AVP is continually growing our partnership list and there is a chance your club/organization has not been added to the dropdown list yet.  Don’t worry though!  You can simply select, ‘Other’ in the dropdown and write in your club/organization.

If you are experiencing issues or have questions regarding your membership, please contact us at memberships@avp.com. [...] Yes!  AVP members can upgrade their membership at any time and do NOT need to wait until their current membership expires.  Simply log-in, select ‘Upgrade’ on the left-side menu, and select the membership tier you wish to upgrade to.  Once payment is completed, your new membership tier is activated immediately and you have 365 days before it expires.

##### What is AVP’s refund policy for memberships?

All services (including but not limited to AVP Memberships) rendered by the AVP are non-refundable. However, if you don’t love our services or have a technical problem, let us know and we’ll try to make it right. We stand behind our services and want to ensure our customers feel the same. For inquiries, please contact memberships@avp.com. [...] ##### My child is under 18 years old and already has an AVP membership but he/she can no longer renew or pay for his/her membership (their profile has an alert saying he/she needs a linked parent/guardian account). Why did this happen and what should we do?

In order to protect children under the age of 18, the AVP is now requiring all U18 accounts to have a parent/guardian account linked to it (allowing the parent/guardian account to manage and pay for the child’s online account). Please follow the below steps to resolve this.
